title: Code and data for: Heart transplantation in Brazil's public health system, 2000–2025: a nationwide analysis of network growth, regional utilization and center volume
description: Analysis code and aggregated results for the article. The code downloads the public SIH/SUS hospital discharge files (DATASUS) and reproduces the tables and figures. No record-level data are included; centers are identified only by codes.
